craft_notes: Sthāyin: range-not-fight (passions RANGED, never fought — the block-thesis). Sanskrit: kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryagocare...tattvam avaśiṣyate → L4 keeps six-charge list whole line 1. Rows: row 1 (six uncut). Close: remains (avaśiṣyate — reality IS what's left when listed: subtraction-refrain). Rejected: 'overcome the six' — killed: in-the-range kept (gocara as territory); 'temptations' — killed: charges kept (the list is precise).

lines: Passion-range — lust, anger, greed, delusion, pride, envy:
uncaused intellect made there — reality remains.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kāmakrodhalobhamohamadamātsaryagocare | buddhiṃ nistimitāṃ kṛtvā tat tattvam avaśiṣyate

reads_against.argmap: What remains in the six-passion range? → Uncaused within the whole passion-range, reality remains what it was.
